****_Superman/Batman_ #72**** is an issue of the series [_Superman/Batman_ (Volume 1)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman_Vol_1 "Superman/Batman Vol 1") with a cover date of [July, 2010](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2010,_July "Category:2010, July"). It was published on May 19, 2010.

## Synopsis for "Worship"

[Superman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Kal-El_(New_Earth) "Kal-El (New Earth)") flies through space to take care of a dangerous comet on a collision course towards Earth. He destroys the comet, but trace amounts of [Green Kryptonite](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Kryptonite "Green Kryptonite") are present and temporarily weakens Superman's powers. He crash lands on an [alien](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Alien "Alien") planet and levels a civilian construct. He executes a quick rebuild and flies back towards Earth.

## Appearing in "Worship"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [Superman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Kal-El_(New_Earth) "Kal-El (New Earth)")
*   [Batman](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Bruce_Wayne_(New_Earth) "Bruce Wayne (New Earth)")

## Notes

*   This issue is reprinted in _[Superman/Batman: Worship](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman:\_Worship\_(Collected) "Superman/Batman: Worship (Collected)")_, _[Superman/Batman Vol. 6](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman\_Vol.\_6\_(Collected) "Superman/Batman Vol. 6 (Collected)")_ and _[Superman/Batman Omnibus Vol. 2](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Superman/Batman\_Omnibus\_Vol.\_2\_(Collected) "Superman/Batman Omnibus Vol. 2 (Collected)")_.
*   This issue includes a four-page preview of [_Green Arrow_ (Volume 4) #1](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Arrow_Vol_4_1 "Green Arrow Vol 4 1").
